name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Five input buffer stages. F6 cycles on desktop; use the Buffer stage setting on Android.

orb-buffer.name: Orb pre-click
orb-buffer.description: If you click shortly before touching an orb, the click is applied when you touch it. Uses the same window as the stage.

debug.name: Show debug popups
debug.description: Shows a popup each time a jump release is held back, so you can tell the buffer is working.
